stage: production isolation and clean initialization; no deployment

resourceDelta.pauseReason: Free limit is two active projects; source and unrelated selfidbox currently occupy both. Paused projects do not count. No other project is changed.
resourceDelta.vercelRules: Empty project on existing plan; no Git connection/autodeploy, no paid options, no deployment, no custom domain/DNS. Use its actual platform-assigned default domain only.
resourceDelta.initialize: After validating the exact newly created empty target: existing 20 migrations in order, 24 empty pm tables, only 2 private application buckets, matching migration history, separately generated runtime/maintenance credentials. No source dump, users, sessions, files or test fixture SQL imported.
resourceDelta.authConfiguration: New-target only: verified email confirmation, minimum password12; existing approved QQ SMTP and numeric Token templates copied by owner to provider console. No registration or email send; no SMTP provider investigation.
resourceDelta.environmentConfiguration: Only new production Vercel project's Production scope using new target public key/service key/runtime6543/event5432/CA/ref and actual production origin; separate local maintenance credentials/key. Existing staging and its Preview variables untouched; no production secret in any Preview or Development scope.
resourceDelta.maintenance: Bind exact new target in local backup/status/scoped-cleanup guards without loosening default lab or local-only restore guard. Necessary local validation and read-only/new-empty-target checks; no cleanup apply, restore, automatic backup schedule or new Drive upload.

successState.testLab: INACTIVE, original data retained; old Preview unavailable until a separately planned free-slot switch

failureState: If target prerequisites are unavailable or creation cannot proceed, pause only the newly created target if any and restore the original lab; preserve new target and diagnostics, no second project, no delete/reset or paid fallback. Agent continues technical preparation.
manualHandoff: One bundled credential/configuration handoff after new resource IDs exist. Credentials remain in ignored private files/provider console, never chat; keep new backup key independently on phone. No actual mail/phone business retest.
remainingApproval: Separate final publication/deployment approval only after all release gates pass.
